content: Lord Mayor of London residing at Crosby Place, a hundred yards away
A furred gown and a straight face on the steps. He does not speak.
His responses are short and cold, and he does not speak to William.
He sat, and he did not speak. On Friday he was not in the lane, and he did not speak.
He answers the litany short and cold, three pews off, and he does not look across.
